title: Parenting
definition: Parenting is the God-given responsibility of raising, teaching, nurturing, discipling, and guiding children toward maturity and faithfulness.
summary: Children are a gift from God entrusted to parents for a season of guidance and discipleship. Parenting involves more than meeting physical needs; it includes teaching God's truth, modeling faith, correcting lovingly, encouraging growth, and preparing children to follow Christ. No parent fulfills this responsibility perfectly, but God provides wisdom and grace for those who seek Him.
christFocus: Jesus welcomed children, valued them deeply, and demonstrated the loving guidance that parents are called to reflect.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Parents play a significant role in shaping a child's understanding of God, relationships, character, and truth. Understanding biblical parenting helps families build foundations that encourage lifelong faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Prioritize spiritual formation alongside physical care. Model the faith you desire your children to embrace. Pray for them regularly, teach Scripture consistently, and remember that faithful parenting depends upon God's grace rather than perfection.
